tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every surface. Never put text straight on it except page titles and section labels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one surface: cards, the day panel, dialogs. A group of content gets one surface, never a surface inside a surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Pressed-in fills inside a surface: chips, summary tiles, the date pill, quiet buttons. Replaces inner borders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows inside one surface. Not for boxing things in.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and numbers on bg, surface and surface-sunk (17:1 / 15:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: categories, weekdays, helper lines, on surface and surface-sunk (6.9:1 / 7.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Captions, counts, timestamps, placeholders, on surface, bg and surface-sunk (4.8:1 / 4.5:1). The lightest text allowed.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single action colour: primary button, selected tab underline, today, links. Text in accent reads on surface (5.2:1 / 6.6:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (5.2:1 / 7:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected chip or the selected day.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft (6.6:1 / 8.4:1).

tokens.name: petal
tokens.usage: The brand pink of the flower mark and of a day where everything got done. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: petal-peach
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: food, the unneeded half of the spending split. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: petal-butter
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: cafe, warmth. Decorative only.

tokens.name: petal-mint
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: transport, the needed half of the spending split, a goal met. Decorative only.

tokens.name: petal-lilac
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: culture, Mallow's feelings. Decorative only.

tokens.name: petal-sky
tokens.usage: Pastel fill: fixed costs, rain. Decorative only.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: 'Needed', saved, done, income. Text on surface (5.2:1 / 9.4:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: 'Unneeded', delete, errors. Text on surface (5.3:1 / 7:1); as a fill, text on it is on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill: the Delete button of a confirm dialog (5.3:1 / 7.4:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px off the element. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: The day's date at the top of the diary and the day panel. One per screen.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: The one big number of a summary (this period's spending).

styles.name: writing
styles.usage: What people write: the diary, notes. Never smaller.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Rows, lists, buttons, everything read in passing.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and group labels, chips, tabs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts, timestamps, day totals, in ink-3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, chip to chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows of a list, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside tiles and rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; between groups inside a surface.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Surface padding; between sections inside a surface.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between surfaces; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page regions.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, tiles, inputs, rows.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: Surfaces and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the date pill, the save dot.

shadow.note: Shadows separate a surface from the ground; borders do not.

tokens.name: shadow-surface
tokens.usage: Every surface at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, Mallow's button.
